column2: Royal envoy, I'd like to put this boy's parents at ease. May we go?
Yeah, sure. Take care.
Thank you so much.
Reunion (First)
Hello.
Um, you're...
Thanks for the other day. You're very brave, aren't you?
...Nah, not really.
Those guys were doing something that stupid to a kid, so...
What's your name?
Rudi... Rudi Trier.
I'm Savia. Are you a noble?
Sort of... not a very important one. ...I do stuff like being a special envoy for the royal family.
Huh, so there are decent people among the western nobles too.
The only nobles we poor easterners ever meet are arrogant types like those.
Well, there are all kinds of people...
What do you do?
I look after poor children and teach them to read and write.
Drop by next time you're around here. Tell me about your travels.
If you ask the children, I'm sure they'll tell you where I am.
Oh, yeah. I'll drop by.
See you, then. Thank you.
Reunion
Rudi! You came?
Oh, yeah, I happened to be nearby, so.
Will you tell me about your travels? I'm sure the children will love it too.
Sure, no problem.
Then, this way.
I'm sorry for keeping you so late.
Not at all. I'm traveling alone anyway. It was fun.
Thank you, Rudi. The children were so happy.
If stories like mine are good enough, I've got plenty.
Rudi, come again. I'll be waiting.
Yeah, I'll come again for sure.
Armored Man
Militia/Rebel
Hey, are you the ones causing trouble around here?
And what if we are?
I won't let you pull this kind of thing while I'm around.
Cheeky brat!
That all? Not so tough!
You... you mean to get in our way...
Another one, huh... Pretty hulking guy. I'll take you all on at once.
...I'll crush you...
Secret Meeting
Savia, what are you doing here?
I'm sorry. This is so sudden.
No, thanks for back then. You saved me...
I was looking for you, you know. I wanted to thank you...
...Rudi, I need your help with that.
Ever since then, I've been chased by the armored men who captured you...
I've been running all this time, but I have nowhere left to go...
I see... it's my fault...
...I know, I've got a good idea. Run west.
To the royal palace. Believe it or not, I've got a fair bit of pull.
I'll write a letter right now. Take it and show it to anyone at the palace.
I'm sure they'll take you on. Those guys can't chase you all the way to the great palace in the west, right?
...Yes... but are you sure?
Yeah, it's fine. I'm the one you saved.
Now it's my turn.
